THESE APPEALS COMING ON FOR FINAL HEARING, THIS DAY, JUDGMENT WAS DELIVERED THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE E.S.INDIRESH
ORAL JUDGMENT Heard the learned counsel appearing for the parties.

2. These appeals are arising out of the judgment and award dated 02.08.2018 in MVC No.76/2016 on the file of the II Additional Senior Civil Judge and MACT, Kalaburagi (for short 'the Tribunal'),
partly allowing the claim petition and awarding compensation to the claimant.

entities.text: II Additional Senior Civil Judge and MACT, Kalaburagi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: NC: 2026:KHC-K:890 HC-KAR 3.
For the sake of convenience, the parties would be referred to as per their rank before the Tribunal.
4. The relevant facts for adjudication of these appeals are that, on 05.05.2015, the claimant was proceeding towards railway station as a pedestrian.
At that time, Autorickshaw bearing No.KA-32/B-4339 came in rash and negligent manner and dashed to the claimant and on account of the same, the claimant sustained grievous injuries.
Hence, the claimant has filed MVC No.76/2016 before the Tribunal, seeking compensation.

Rajkumar vs Syed Faheem And Anr on 3 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/151473528/
3 5.

entities.text: Rajkumar vs Syed Faheem And Anr

sentences.text:
After service of notice, respondent No.2- Insurance Company has filed the written statement,
admitting the policy, however, taken a contention that, the same is subject to the terms and conditions of the policy.
6.
In order to prove the case, the claimant examined himself as PW.1 and the doctor as PW.2 and got marked 13 documents as Exs.P1 to P13.
Respondent No.2- Insurance Company has examined its officer as RW.1, NC: 2026:KHC-K:890 HC-KAR however, no document was produced on behalf of the respondents.

7. The Tribunal, after considering the material on record, by judgment and award dated 02.08.2018,
awarded compensation of Rs.2,09,500/- with interest at 6% per annum from the date of petition till realization and directed respondent No.2-Insurance Company to deposit the same.

Feeling aggrieved by the judgment and award passed by the Tribunal, the Insurance Company has preferred MFA No.202282/2018, challenging the liability and the claimant has preferred MFA No.200475/2019, seeking enhancement of compensation.

8. Smt. Preeti Patil Melkundi, learned counsel appearing for the Insurance Company argued that,
the vehicle in question, i.e., the offending autorickshaw was not insured with the Insurance Company and therefore, the Tribunal was not justified in saddling the liability on the Insurance Company and hence, sought for interference of this Court.

It is also argued by the learned counsel NC: 2026:KHC-K:890 HC-KAR appearing for the Insurance Company that, the award of compensation is on the higher side, which requires to be reduced in this appeal.

9. Per contra, Sri Sanjeev Patil, learned counsel appearing for the claimant submitted that, after filing of the written statement by the Insurance Company before the Tribunal, additional written statement was filed, which came to be rejected by the Tribunal and being aggrieved by the same, the Insurance Company has preferred W.P.No.200949/2018 and this Court, vide order dated 22.06.2018, dismissed the writ petition filed by the Insurance Company and the same has reached finality and therefore submitted that, the said argument advanced by the learned counsel appearing for the Insurance Company cannot be accepted.
10.

Insofar as the award of compensation is concerned, it is argued by the learned counsel appearing for the claimant that, the award made by the Tribunal is meager, which requires to be enhanced in this appeal.
NC: 2026:KHC-K:890 HC-KAR 11.

In the light of the submissions made by the learned counsel appearing for the parties, though the learned counsel appearing for the Insurance Company argued that the policy has not been issued, a perusal of the records makes it clear that, the order dated 22.06.2018 passed in W.P.No.200949/2018, dismissing the writ petition filed by the Insurance Company as to filing the additional written statement denying the admission made in the earlier written statement as to admitting the policy in force has reached finality and therefore, no interference is called for.
Therefore, the appeal filed by the Insurance Company deserves to be dismissed.

sentences.text:
Insofar as the enhancement of compensation is concerned, the accident is of the year 2015 and therefore, considering the notional income of the appellant at Rs.8,000/- per month as per the guidelines of the Karnataka Legal Services Authority and taking into consideration the permanent disability to the extent of NC: 2026:KHC-K:890 HC-KAR 15% and also applying the appropriate multiplier of '15', the loss of future earnings would be Rs.2,16,000/- (Rs.8,000x12x15x15%).
13.

Taking into consideration the injuries sustained by the claimant as per the wound certificate at-Ex.P7 and the disability certificate at Ex.P12, I am of the view that, the award made by the Tribunal requires to be reassessed and accordingly, the same is re-assessed as follows:
Pain and suffering Rs.40,000/-
Medical expenses Rs.38,200/-
Loss of future earnings Rs.2,16,000/-
Loss of income during laid up period Rs.24,000/-
(Rs.8,000 x 3)
Attendant charges and conveyance Rs.10,000/-
charges Loss of amenities Rs.25,000/-
Nutrition food Rs.10,000/-
Total Rs.3,63,200/-
Less: awarded by Tribunal Rs.2,09,500/-
Enhancement: Rs.1,53,700/-

Thus, the claimant is entitled for enhanced compensation of Rs.1,53,700/- with interest at 6% per annum.
NC: 2026:KHC-K:890 HC-KAR 14.

In the result, I pass the following:
ORDER (i) MFA No.202282/2018 filed by the Insurance Company is hereby dismissed.

(ii) MFA No.200475/2019 filed by the claimant is allowed in part and the appellant/claimant is entitled for enhanced compensation of Rs.1,53,700/- with interest at 6% per annum from the date of petition till realisation.
(iii) The appellant in MFA No.202282/2018- Insurance Company is directed to deposit the aforesaid compensation amount within six weeks from the date of receipt of a certified copy of this judgment.
